text:
Sam: quick post-allhands q: during the town hall there was a slide about midyear performance calibrations  when should managers expect final decisions to land? some teams are trying to plan org changes.
Priya K: short answer: final calibration packets go to comp on the 3rd Monday after cycle close, decisions shared within 10 business days after that. timeline in bullets below.
Jordan: can managers submit late evidence if something important surfaces after calibration?
Priya K: yes but use the 'post-calibration evidence' flow. it requires manager sign-off + skip-level note. those are reviewed but only in exceptional cases.
Lina: how are bonuses treated for midyear promotions vs end-of-year? do promoted folks get pro-rated bonuses?
Priya K: good q. policy: bonus eligibility follows the effective date of promotion. if promotion occurs mid-cycle, bonus is prorated for the portion of the cycle in the new band, unless comp approves an exception.
Sam: is there a short script we can use when talking to ICs about denied promos? want to avoid sounding vague.
Priya K: here's a manager-friendly script we use in the doc:```
Thanks for your work here. the calibration panel reviewed X, Y, Z artifacts and decided to [outcome]. the areas we considered were impact, scope, and leadership. here are concrete next steps: 1) target projects to demonstrate X, 2) timeline for re-review (3-6 months), 3) resources/training. we'll document this and follow up.
```
People Ops Bot: Reminder: office hours for managers tomorrow 9am PT. RSVP in the calendar invite.
Ravi: for leveling appeals, what's the fastest path? manager escalation to people ops or formal appeal form?
Priya K: escalate to your HRBP first with the appeal form attached. if it's time-sensitive, note "urgent-review" and include new measurable evidence. we aim to respond in 14 business days for escalations.
Jordan: one more: are market adjustments considered outside the normal promo cycle? some of our roles are seeing rapid market movement.
Priya K: yes, market adjustments can be requested any time via the comp review process. they require benchmarking data and comp sign-off. expect a 21-business-day window typically.
Lina: can we get the checklist link again? my leads missed it in the chat.
People Ops Bot: Link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/midyear-calibration-checklist (internal). includes templates, scripts, and the appeal form.
Sam: perfect. i'll share with my managers and prep any cases that look like exceptions. thanks all. :raised_hands:
Priya K: thanks everyone  happy to take follow-ups in office hours or here. remember to attach evidence to the form.
People Ops Bot: Note: keep all review artifacts in Lattice for audit and future calibrations.
